description: DCM Shriram Industries Limited engages in the production and sale of sugar, alcohol, and power products in India and Nepal. It offers crystal sugar, breakfast, caster, icing, and bulk sugar; demerara pouches, cubes, and sachets; white sugar sachets and cubes; alcohol products, such as ethanol/anhydrous alcohol (AA), extra-neutral alcohol (ENA), rectified spirit, IMFL / IMIL, and country liquor for industrial, food and beverage, pharmaceutical, and ethanol blending program (EBP) sectors; alcohol by-products, as well as provides green power directly back to the power grid. DCM Shriram Industries Limited was founded in 1889 and is based in New Delhi, India.
